competitors.name: Strava
competitors.tagline: Social fitness tracker with running/cycling focus and route discovery
competitors.differentiation: Largest social network for athletes with 100M+ users; route discovery and segment competition are core moats
weaknesses: Shallow coaching — no VDOT, no ACWR, no personalized daily guidance
Training plans are generic, not adaptive

competitors.name: Runna
competitors.tagline: AI-powered personalized running plans with elite coaching guidance
competitors.differentiation: AI-adaptive plans that adjust to your performance; Olympic-level coaching philosophy; distance-specific plans from 5K to ultramarathon
weaknesses: No daily run/rest recommendation beyond the plan

competitors.name: Nike Run Club
competitors.tagline: Free guided runs and coaching with Nike brand integration
competitors.differentiation: Completely free; high production value audio coaching; strong brand

competitors.name: TrainingPeaks
competitors.tagline: Endurance training platform for coaches and self-coached athletes
competitors.differentiation: Professional-grade training load management; coach ecosystem with paid coaching services

competitors.name: Garmin Connect
competitors.tagline: Device-ecosystem fitness tracking with Garmin Coach plans
competitors.differentiation: Deep hardware integration; Training Readiness and Body Battery are unique data signals

competitors.name: Runalyze
competitors.tagline: Data-intensive running analytics with VDOT and training load metrics
competitors.differentiation: Free, open-source analytics depth; closest competitor on VDOT methodology

userComplaints.complaint: Strava's training insights are shallow — just pace charts, no coaching
Running apps give generic plans that don't adapt when you miss days or feel off
No app tells me whether I should actually run today based on my fatigue
Shoe tracking is either missing or buried in settings
Race predictions feel made up — no methodology explained

notes: Hermes differentiation: VDOT methodology + ACWR injury prevention + daily coaching voice + shoe rotation — no single competitor covers all four
Runna is the closest coaching competitor but lacks injury prevention signals
Runalyze is the closest analytics competitor but lacks daily coaching and mobile experience
Strava dominates social but is weakest on coaching depth
